purpose: Two-seed all-30 diagnostic of a restricted manuscript-objective critic; no ATE or neural claim.
critic: bounded-probit linear q0 and nested q1, independently empirical-Brier-fitted on first 2/3 of D
encoder_search: 41-point fixed r grid [-1,1], minimise clipped q0-minus-q1 Brier gap on last 1/3 D, tie tolerance1e-12 then min abs r then r
audit: independent S; clipped gap <=2SE zero-null nonrejection
claim_boundary: restricted parametric critic only; not neural PROBE and not confirmation
